factual_methodology.summary: ICI weekly long-term estimated flows, money-market assets, September gold ETF report, and IMF COFER checked against primary sources; stock, flow, valuation, universe and period distinguished.

novelty.summary: Week-end 30 September fund-flow reversal, 7 October money-market increase, September WGC gold ETF report, distinct from 5 October.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Both language editions substantively revised; numerically equivalent charts; staging GitHub Actions run 38207542797 passed.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Numerical visual parity EN/PT-BR, units and period labels, source-linked tables, geographic mechanism and causal flow.
visual_evidence_readiness.signature: 3 evidence tables + 6 charts + 1 flow + 1 map each locale

research_depth.summary: Five-week flow series, equity domicile, bond breakdown, money-market stock, gold-ETF/futures divergence, COFER currency shares and nonbank emerging-market funding with alternative tests.

evidence_traceability.summary: ICI releases 7/8 October, WGC gold ETF and market report 7 October, IMF September 30 COFER and IMF April analysis; observation versus release clocks and statistical universes reconciled.

counterfactual_review.summary: Wrapper rotation, world versus domestic equity, cash stock, futures versus gold ETFs and COFER valuation/transaction distinctions all include falsifying conditions.

contrary_evidence: Weekly ICI signs reverse three times in five observations; the latest negative figure cannot establish secular flight.
U.S. domestic-equity withdrawals coincide with world-equity inflows and positive bonds.
Gold ETF demand and COMEX positioning have divergent signed changes.
COFER dollar share changes are not mechanically outright dollar sales.
limitations: ICI estimates limited to U.S. fund universe and are revisable; cash/long-term reporting weeks differ.
Gold-backed ETF, futures positions and official FX reserves have distinct populations.
COFER Q2 data exclude monetary gold, and listing is not beneficial ownership.
notes: Substantive revision 1 supersedes shallow edition. First-party numbers and visual EN/PT parity checked; successful staging CI 38207542797. No external independent peer-review claim.

en.title: Global Wealth Flow Monitor — diverging US fund demand, gold positioning and reserve diversification
en.deck: US domestic equity outflows contrasted with world-equity inflows, money-market funds rebuilt liquidity, and gold ETF purchases diverged from Treasury yields and futures positioning.
en.regime: Selective risk demand: volatile fund flows, large liquid buffers, positive physical gold ETF buying, and gradual official reserve diversification.
en.key_risk: A negative combined fund-flow reading alongside rebuilding money-market balances may signal more selective risk demand rather than broad-based rotation.

pt-BR.title: Global Wealth Flow Monitor — fluxos americanos divergentes, ouro e diversificação de reservas

pt-BR.regime: Demanda seletiva: fluxos voláteis, liquidez elevada, compras de ETFs de ouro físico e diversificação oficial gradual.
pt-BR.key_risk: Fluxos combinados negativos e recomposição de fundos monetários podem sinalizar seletividade, não rotação generalizada de risco.
